title: 小小英文新鲜事 - 1011 | 猎豹五胞胎、远古水獭、火星伴蜂巢
description:
🎧 本期音频为全英文，适合有一定英语基础的小朋友。

👧 今天 Mia 和 Lina 聊了三个新鲜事：

🐆 史密森尼动物园迎来猎豹五胞胎，新手妈妈 Zura 超给力！

🔭 今晚抬头看：火星穿过蜂巢星团，红彤彤超好看！

🇬🇧 In today's episode:

🐆 Five baby cheetahs were born at the Smithsonian Zoo!
🦦 A 165-million-year-old otter-like mammal fossil found in China!
🔭 Mars is passing through the Beehive star cluster tonight!

📖 Word of the day: cub

🎮 Riddle time: spots like a leopard, faster than a car, says meow — what am I?

📝 生词本 Words to learn

1. cub（幼崽）
a baby animal, like a baby lion or bear
例：five cheetah cubs（五只猎豹宝宝）

2. pile（堆叠）
to put things on top of each other
例：they pile up to nap（它们堆在一起睡觉）

3. fossil（化石）
what's left of an animal or plant from long ago, turned into rock
例：a dinosaur fossil（恐龙化石）

4. cluster（一团；星团）
a group of the same things close together
例：a star cluster（星团）
